## The Convergence of Marketing, PR, and IT
MK Publicity bridges the critical gap between brand perception (PR), commercial acquisition (Performance Marketing), and digital infrastructure (IT Solutions):
1. **Strategic Public Relations (PR)**: Press release syndication, national & regional media coverage, crisis communication, award nominations, executive personal branding.
2. **Performance Marketing & Digital Advertising**: Omnichannel paid media (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn, YouTube), Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), automated funnel architecture, ROAS-driven customer acquisition.
3. **IT Solutions & MarTech Systems**: Custom web application development, CRM and MarTech automation, cloud infrastructure, AI-driven marketing workflows, enterprise portal development, high-speed landing page systems.
4. **Brand Architecture & Creative Media**: Cinematic corporate video production, complete visual identity systems, e-commerce marketplace optimization (Amazon, Flipkart).
